[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:385YE Winter]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Announced by Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, Master of the Koboldi">To commission the House of Illumination and Light Market in Cargo in Redoubt and Essk in Miekarova respectively, creating two Imperial titles: the Architect of Illumination and Merchant Boyar of the Light Market. In the spirit of partnerships and prosperity this commission was designed for, I profusely thank Bledri and Siân of the Eternal Family in Navarr, who have pledged 10 wains to this construction.</quote>
==Overview==
* Creates two sinecures in [[Redoubt]] and [[Miekarova]] as per the '''[[Out_of_the_abyss#Illumination|Out of the abyss]]''' wind of fortune
* Announcement by the [[Master of the Koboldi]]
==Date==
* Winter 385YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 75 wains of white granite
* 225 crowns
* Six months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|House_of_Illumination_and_Light_Market}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, the [[Architect of Illumination]] will be available to elect by [[Tally of the Votes]] of Urizen [[mana site]] owners for the first time at the Winter Solstice 387YE.
* Now complete, the [[Merchant Boyar of the Light Market]] will be available to elect by [[Tally of the Votes]] of Varushkan [[forest]] and [[mine]] owners for the first time at the Winter Solstice 387YE for a shortened term of three seasons.
